name: CiteEval
intro: CiteEval是一个基于原则的引用评估框架，旨在对生成文本中的引用质量进行细粒度评估。该框架不仅考虑被引用的来源，还涵盖了检索上下文、用户查询和生成的文本。基于此框架，研究人员构建了CiteBench，一个带有人工高质量标注的多领域基准。为了实现高效评估，还开发了与人类判断高度相关的模型指标套件CiteEval-Auto。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
metric: Context Attribution, Citation Editing, Citation Rating, Correlation with human judgment
intro_en: CiteEval is a principle-based citation evaluation framework designed for fine-grained assessment of citation quality in generated text. The framework considers not only the cited sources but also the retrieval context, user queries, and the generated text. Based on this framework, researchers developed CiteBench, a multi-domain benchmark with high-quality human annotations. To enable efficient evaluation, they also created CiteEval-Auto, a suite of model metrics highly correlated with human judgments.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.01829. The paper introduces CiteEval as a principle-driven framework that evaluates citations against full retrieval sources and beyond-retrieval context, including user query, response context, and parametric knowledge. CiteBench construction focuses on LFQA query sampling, passage retrieval, and one-pass response plus citation generation. The benchmark samples ASQA, ELI5, MS MARCO, and LFRQA-style domains, provides fixed retrieval passages, generates cited responses from GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3-70b, and Llama-3-8b, then annotates 1,200 instances with 200 for metric development and 1,000 for meta-evaluation. Human annotation proceeds statement by statement through context attribution to retrieval, user, response, or parametric context; citation editing with delete and add actions such as misleading, substandard, redundant, evidence, refinement, and credibility; and 1-5 Likert citation ratings. Quality control uses three blind annotation passes, majority vote and averaged ratings, linguist validation, pilot rounds, and reported IAA. CiteEval-Auto is then validated by correlation with human statement and response ratings and used to benchmark RAG citation quality.
